sentence: With access to the Internet come some truly life-changing advantages.
translation: 接入互联网，一些真正改变生活的好处便随之而来。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：介词短语 With access to the Internet 置于句首引起完全倒装——正常语序 Some truly life-changing advantages come with access to the Internet；倒装把“前提”（联网）放句首、把“主语”（好处）压轴，强调好处之多之新 | 谓语 come 复数与真正的主语 advantages 呼应——倒装句主谓一致认后面的主语，语法填空高频陷阱 | access to 使用权、接入（have/gain access to；accessible 可获得的）| life-changing 复合形容词“改变生活的”| truly 副词强化
pattern: With + N + come(s) + 主语（完全倒装）
imitationCn: 随着阅读习惯的养成，一些真正受益终身的改变便随之而来。
imitationHint: With the habit of reading come → some truly lifelong benefits（倒装；谓语随后面的主语用复数）
imitationAnswer: With the habit of reading come some truly lifelong benefits.

sentence: In the time it takes to find one book in the library, we can use a search engine to bring up millions of results.
translation: 在图书馆找到一本书的工夫，我们就能用搜索引擎调出上百万条结果。
analysis: In the time (that) it takes to do sth：“在做某事所需的时间里”——time 后省略关系词的定语从句，内嵌 it takes to do 耗时句型；这个时间状语框架专门用来做效率对比 | one book vs millions of results：数字的悬殊对撞（1 : 1,000,000），说明文量化对比的极致 | bring up 调出、使显示在屏幕上（熟词僻义！课堂 bring up 四义：调出/提起话题/抚养/呕吐）| a search engine 搜索引擎 | 用“旧方式的时间”丈量“新方式的产出”——科技类作文的效率论证模板
pattern: In the time it takes to + V ..., S + can + V + to bring up + N
imitationCn: 在手写一封信的工夫，我们就能用语音输入发出几十条消息。
imitationHint: In the time it takes to write one letter by hand, we can use voice input → to send dozens of messages
imitationAnswer: In the time it takes to write one letter by hand, we can use voice input to send dozens of messages.

sentence: No wonder the Internet has now become the first place that the majority of people turn to for information.
translation: 难怪互联网如今已成为大多数人查找信息的首选之地。
analysis: No wonder + 从句：难怪……（It's no wonder that... 的省略，呼应必修二 U2 太极单元同句型——跨书复现）| the first place that... turn to：先行词被 the first 修饰，关系词用 that；turn to 求助于——介词 to 悬空从句末（turn to the place → the place that people turn to），介词悬空三连：attach importance to / get rid of / turn to | the majority of 大多数（谓语随 of 后名词）| for information 表目的 | 现在完成时 has become 强调“已然如此”
pattern: No wonder + S + has become + the first place that + S + turn to + for + N
imitationCn: 难怪短视频平台已成为许多年轻人打发闲暇的首选去处。
imitationHint: No wonder short-video platforms have become the first place that → many young people turn to for their spare time（to 悬空句尾）
imitationAnswer: No wonder short-video platforms have become the first place that many young people turn to for their spare time.

sentence: You can have food delivered to you using food delivery apps and sites.
translation: 通过外卖应用和网站，你可以让人把食物送上门。
analysis: have sth done 使役被动：have food delivered“让食物被送来”——自己不动手、安排别人做，宾补用过去分词表被动（课堂三态：have sb do 让某人做 / have sb doing 让某人持续做 / have sth done 让某事被做）| using... 现在分词作方式状语（= by using）| food delivery apps and sites 名词作定语连环（外卖类应用与网站）| deliver 课堂拓展：deliver a speech 发表演讲、delivery n. 递送（on delivery 货到时）| 互联网生活场景句：一句话装下“外卖时代”
pattern: S + can have + O + V-ed + using + N（have sth done）
imitationCn: 通过在线打印服务，你可以让复习资料直接送到宿舍。
imitationHint: You can have your revision materials delivered to your dormitory → using online printing services（have sth done）
imitationAnswer: You can have your revision materials delivered to your dormitory using online printing services.

sentence: Gone are the days of searching shop after shop for the perfect pair of boots.
translation: 一家店一家店地寻找那双完美靴子的日子，一去不复返了。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：表语（过去分词 Gone）置于句首引起完全倒装——正常语序 The days... are gone；Gone are the days (of/when...) 是感叹时代变迁的固定名句式（课堂例句：Gone are the days when humans had to do hard physical work to survive.）| shop after shop：名词 after 名词表“一个接一个”（day after day / wave after wave），把逛街的疲惫感直接写进节奏里 | searching... for 搜寻 | the perfect pair of boots 具体到一双靴子——以小物写大时代，比空谈“网购便利”生动百倍
pattern: Gone are the days of + V-ing + N after N + for + N（表语倒装）
imitationCn: 一页一页翻字典查单词的日子，一去不复返了。
imitationHint: Gone are the days of turning page after page → in the dictionary for one word（Gone 置句首倒装 + N after N）
imitationAnswer: Gone are the days of turning page after page in the dictionary for one word.

sentence: Above all else, the Internet helps us establish and maintain social ties.
translation: 最重要的是，互联网帮助我们建立并维系社会纽带。
analysis: Above all else 最重要的是（= most important of all；比 above all 更强调“高于其余一切”）——建议/论证清单的压轴标记，呼应必修二 U2 的 Above all | help sb (to) do：省 to 不定式 | establish and maintain 动词并列：“建立”与“维系”一先一后覆盖关系的全生命周期——动词搭配的时间逻辑 | social ties 社会纽带（tie 熟词僻义：纽带、联系；family ties 亲情纽带）| establish 课堂网络：establish a relationship with 建立关系、establish oneself as 确立地位、well-established 久负盛名的
pattern: Above all else, S + helps us + V₁ and V₂ + N
imitationCn: 最重要的是，社团活动帮助我们建立并维系真挚的友谊。
imitationHint: Above all else, club activities help us → establish and maintain sincere friendships
imitationAnswer: Above all else, club activities help us establish and maintain sincere friendships.

sentence: As with any great invention, we must be aware of these problems and be careful to use the Internet properly and responsibly.
translation: 正如对待任何伟大的发明一样，我们必须意识到这些问题，谨慎地以恰当负责的方式使用互联网。
analysis: As with + 名词：复合介词“正如对……一样”（= Just like the case of...）——把互联网放进“一切伟大发明都有两面”的普遍规律里，一举提升议论的高度 | be aware of 意识到（课堂拓展：raise one's awareness of 提高意识、environmentally aware 有环保意识的）| and 并列两个 be：be aware（认知层）+ be careful（行动层）| properly and responsibly 双副词收尾：恰当地+负责地——副词并列给“怎么用”定标准 | 辩证收束句：不否定技术、只强调态度——科技利弊类作文的标准结论句
pattern: As with any + N, S + must be aware of ... and be careful to + V + adv. and adv.
imitationCn: 正如对待任何新工具一样，我们必须了解人工智能的局限，审慎地以恰当负责的方式使用它。
imitationHint: As with any new tool, we must be aware of AI's limitations → and be careful to use it properly and responsibly
imitationAnswer: As with any new tool, we must be aware of AI's limitations and be careful to use it properly and responsibly.

sentence: Only in this way can the Internet be a place of discovery, wonder and inspiration for everyone.
translation: 只有这样，互联网才能成为每个人的发现之地、奇迹之地和灵感之地。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：Only + 介词短语（in this way）置于句首引起部分倒装——情态动词 can 提到主语 the Internet 之前；only 修饰状语居首必倒装的三形态（课堂全套）：Only in this way can he.../ Only when she came home did her mother.../ Only then did he... | 注意与完全倒装的区别：部分倒装只提助动词/情态动词 | a place of discovery, wonder and inspiration：of 后三个抽象名词并列——把互联网定义成三重精神空间 | for everyone 收尾点“普惠” | 全文结论句：条件（管好问题）+ 愿景（三名词）一步到位
pattern: Only in this way + can + S + be a place of + N₁, N₂ and N₃（部分倒装）
imitationCn: 只有这样，校园才能成为每个学生的成长之地、探索之地和梦想之地。
imitationHint: Only in this way can the campus be a place of → growth, exploration and dreams for every student（can 提前倒装）
imitationAnswer: Only in this way can the campus be a place of growth, exploration and dreams for every student.

sentence: My eyes were glued to the little screen whenever I walked down the street, had dinner with friends or lay in bed at night.
translation: 无论是走在街上、和朋友吃饭，还是夜里躺在床上，我的眼睛都紧盯着那块小屏幕。
analysis: be glued to 像粘在……上一动不动（glue 胶水的比喻化用法；keep one's eyes glued to sth 目不转睛）——“成瘾”不用 addicted 却更传神 | whenever 引导让步式时间从句“无论何时”，从句内三个谓语并列：walked... had... or lay...（lie-lay-lain 躺，易错动词变位！）——三个场景覆盖行走/社交/独处，成瘾的无孔不入 | My eyes 作主语而非 I：局部代整体，眼睛“被粘住”暗示身不由己 | 自述体开篇的画面化坦白——读后续写“沉迷”主题的示范句
pattern: My eyes were glued to + N + whenever + S + V₁, V₂ or V₃
imitationCn: 无论是排队、坐车，还是课间休息，我的手指都停不下来地刷着屏幕。
imitationHint: My fingers kept scrolling the screen whenever I → queued, took the bus or had a break between classes（三谓语并列）
imitationAnswer: My fingers kept scrolling the screen whenever I queued, took the bus or had a break between classes.

sentence: The first thing I did when I woke up in the morning was reach for my phone.
translation: 早上醒来我做的第一件事，就是伸手去摸手机。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：表语不定式省 to——主语部分含有动词 do 的某种形式（The first thing I did）时，表语不定式的 to 可省略：was (to) reach for...；课堂同族：The first thing to do is (to) tell him. / All she did yesterday was (to) sweep the floor. | The first thing (that) I did：省略 that 的定语从句 + when 时间从句双重嵌套在主语部分 | reach for 伸手去拿（未必拿到，动作定格在“伸手”）| 习惯细节的白描：不评论、只记录，让读者自己认出自己——自省文的开篇钩子
pattern: The first thing + S + did + when-从句 + was + (to) V ...
imitationCn: 下课铃一响我做的第一件事，就是冲向食堂。
imitationHint: The first thing I did when the bell rang was → rush to the canteen（主语含 did，表语省 to）
imitationAnswer: The first thing I did when the bell rang was rush to the canteen.

sentence: Sliding into the habit was easy, but it was difficult to quit the habit.
translation: 不知不觉染上这习惯很容易，但要戒掉它却很难。
analysis: 前后半句的语法对照即是主题对照：前半 Sliding into the habit 动名词短语直接作主语（染上=自然发生，主语位随手可得）；后半 it was difficult to quit 用形式主语（戒掉=刻意工程，得先立 it 再搬 to do）——语法形式与语义难度暗合 | slide into 不自觉地陷入（slide 滑：无摩擦、无知觉；课堂拓展：slide into debt/depression 渐陷债务/抑郁）| quit + 名词/动名词 戒掉（quit smoking；quitter 半途而废者）| easy/difficult 反义对举 + but 转折——一句话写尽成瘾机制
pattern: V-ing + was easy, but it was difficult to + V（动名词主语 vs 形式主语）
imitationCn: 答应下来很容易，但要真正兑现承诺却很难。
imitationHint: Saying yes was easy, → but it was difficult to keep the promise（前动名词主语、后形式主语）
imitationAnswer: Saying yes was easy, but it was difficult to keep the promise.

sentence: The empty hours stretched out in front of me.
translation: 空落落的时间在我面前铺展开来。
analysis: 戒断期的经典一笔：时间被拟物化——stretch out 延展、铺开（本指道路田野：Fields and hills stretched out to the distance.），此处让“空虚的钟点”像一条望不到头的路横在眼前 | empty 移就修辞：空的本是“我”，却说 hours 空 | in front of me 空间化时间——无所事事时时间才“可见” | 短句独立成段的心理低谷标记，为下文“重新发现生活”蓄力——读后续写情绪转折前的“低点句”范本 | stretch 课堂多义：伸展肢体/拉紧绳子/历史上溯（stretch back to）
pattern: The empty + 时间N + stretched out in front of + sb（时间拟物）
imitationCn: 漫长的暑假在我面前铺展开来，一眼望不到头。
imitationHint: The long summer vacation stretched out in front of me, → with no end in sight（时间拟物化）
imitationAnswer: The long summer vacation stretched out in front of me, with no end in sight.
